title: Positions
description: Who's on the field and what each player is actually responsible for.

entries.explanation: The decision-maker. Takes the snap on every play, then either hands the ball off, throws it, or runs it himself. Reads the defense before and after the snap and often changes the play at the line.
entries.example: The QB sees extra rushers coming and quickly flips the ball to a receiver where the defenders just left.

entries.explanation: Takes handoffs and runs through gaps the line opens up. Also catches short passes and blocks rushers to protect the quarterback.
entries.example: On 3rd and 1, the RB follows his blockers up the middle to grind out the first down.

entries.explanation: Lines up wide, runs precise routes, and catches passes. Speed matters, but the real skills are getting open against coverage and holding on through contact.
entries.example: A receiver fakes going deep, cuts sharply back toward the QB, and is suddenly wide open for a 12-yard gain.

entries.explanation: A hybrid: big enough to block next to the linemen, athletic enough to run routes and catch passes. Offenses love tight ends because the defense never knows which job he'll do on a given play.
entries.example: The TE pretends to block, then slips into the open middle of the field for an easy catch.

entries.explanation: The five big players who never touch the ball: a center (who snaps it), two guards, and two tackles. On passes they form a protective pocket around the QB; on runs they shove defenders aside to create lanes. Every play starts with them winning or losing their blocks.
entries.example: The broadcast praises the line when the QB has "all day to throw" — nobody touched him for five full seconds.

entries.explanation: The defense's front wall. Tackles work inside to clog running lanes; ends work outside to chase the QB. Their job is to win the fight at the line before the play can develop.
entries.example: A defensive end beats his blocker around the edge and sacks the quarterback.

entries.explanation: The defense's all-purpose middle layer, lined up behind the linemen. They tackle runners, cover short passes, and sometimes blitz the QB — they have to diagnose the play in about one second and react.
entries.example: The middle linebacker reads the handoff instantly and meets the runner at the line for no gain.

entries.explanation: Covers the wide receivers one-on-one or in a zone, usually on an island far from help. The hardest defensive job: run backwards as fast as the receiver runs forward, without knowing where he's going.
entries.example: The corner stays stride-for-stride with the receiver and knocks the deep pass away at the last moment.

entries.explanation: The last line of defense, starting deepest. Safeties clean up anything that breaks through — the deep pass, the long run — and are usually the defense's play-callers.
entries.example: A runner breaks free, but the safety tracks him down at midfield to save a touchdown.

entries.explanation: Kicks field goals, extra points, and kickoffs off a tee or a hold. Comes on the field for a handful of plays that regularly decide entire games.
entries.example: Down 2 with three seconds left, everything comes down to the kicker's 41-yard attempt.

entries.explanation: Drop-kicks the ball away on 4th down to flip field position. Great punters angle kicks out of bounds near the goal line so there's no return at all.
entries.example: The punter drops one at the 3-yard line, forcing the opponent to drive 97 yards.

entries.explanation: Catches punts and kickoffs and runs them back through traffic. One of the most dangerous jobs — and one of the few where a single player can flip a game in ten seconds.
entries.example: The returner finds a seam up the sideline and takes the kickoff 98 yards to the house.

entries.explanation: A specialist who does one thing perfectly: fire the ball backwards through his legs 8–15 yards to the punter or holder. You only hear his name when something goes wrong.
entries.example: A high snap sails over the punter's head — suddenly the long snapper is the story of the game.
